{{Quote|Thank you for gathering here on such short notice. I am here to&hellip;in the Phu system. We are still analyzing the data from the attack, but we can confirm that General Ares Nune's task force did encounter enemy forces on patrol. In this case, we were able to recover a partial extract from the lead ship's mission recorder.|The Republic admiral|<ref name="HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/hnn/001.html#rss|text=HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided|int=HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided}}</ref>}}
This '''individual''' served as an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
The [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] represented the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Starfleet]] in hosting a [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] press conference shortly after the [[Battle of the Phu system/Legends|destruction]] of [[Ares Nune/Legends|Ares Nune's]] naval task force in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. He exhibited a radio recording from Nune's [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] and told the journalists present that further information would be divulged after they had been studied and declassified.
